description: The sentinels of the materialization fixture that the production eligibility rule keeps out of every view (the sealed audit note is unclassified). AP-03 and AP-05 run the real maintenance service, which applies only that rule, so the fixture's additionally withheld node (north-desk:sealed-ledger, sentinels ZQX*) is published there as it would be in any real run; its sentinels are not checked by those procedures.
